snippet.title: Deep Dark Wrath | v3.0 Frost Flower Gameplay Teaser
snippet.description:
Showcasing Deep Dark Wrath's biggest expansion and final content update, v3.0 Frost Flower! Venture the Frost, Power up the Frost Flower, Access Even stronger Enchanted Cards, and Rid the Wrath and Darkness of the Dungeon! Are you up for the challenge?

Deep Dark Wrath is a hand-drawn, card collecting, dungeon-crawler where you fend off countless enemies and find its source with the help of powerful Enchanted Cards. The game is currently available on Windows and Android(via APK), and will set to release a Linux and SteamOS native port once the v3.0 Update releases!
